generator.algorithm: SHA-256 counter mapping: digest(seed || NUL || field), unsigned big-endian modulo inclusive integer interval; position quarter-cell index mapped to coordinate / 4
generator.seed_derivation: first 8 bytes of SHA-256('relief-v1|' || split || '|' || stratum || '|' || index), unsigned big-endian
generator.base_scenario: schema relief-engineering/1 control fixture; external_commitment fixture only for its named stratum
generator.platforms: exactly 3 UAVs and 1 helicopter; local platforms remain in the local 2x2 block; external-commitment stratum keeps the helicopter and its initial commitment outside the block
generator.tasks: retain the six-task base roster; external-commitment stratum retains the single named outside delivery

strata_per_split.failure: one UAV failure and its report
strata_per_split.stock_loss: one public delayed depot stock loss
strata_per_split.combined: one failure, one energy change, one stock loss, and delayed reports
strata_per_split.external_commitment: one outside delivery kept with its initial helicopter carrier

generator.allocation: equal parent counts per stratum: 8 each in train and heldout, 2 each in development; generation order split then stratum then index
constraints: All initial deliveries have quantity no greater than the initial carrier capacity.
Initial queues retain valid capability and local-area assignments.
Initial commodity stock covers all listed delivery demand before exogenous stock loss.
Every task deadline is within the fixed 60-minute horizon.
No scenario is removed, replaced, or re-seeded based on its outcome.
generator.heldout_access: scenario files and hashes are registered before training; no policy outcomes or metrics are opened until all six final checkpoints pass the evaluation barrier
